notes.title: 🏮The one-day romance drama "One Day of Romance" is now officially live on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/0c7e5edc4df9d6bb036a692287f7d17b1d4ed9f9.png[/img]
[h4]👇️ [Head to the Rendezvous Immediately, Unveil the Millennia-Old Romance Scheme] [/h4]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690230/_/
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🍧Game Introduction：[/h2]
[quote=author] 🏮Chang'an Moon Rises, Painted Boats Sway with Candles
——As a mysterious passerby in the brothel, use wisdom and strategy to uncover the dusty past beneath the prosperous facade💌.....In the ancient charm world of poetry, wine, and romance🍶, experience segments of entangled and poignant destined encounters💫 [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/744d994759a2aaaf8a0f707f5d29888b31091ff9.png[/img]
[quote=author] Encounter five stunning beauties: The strategizing manager🌺, the charming and seductive noble sister💋, the gentle and proper lady🎐, the karma-entangled cat spirit🐾, the enigmatic girl with shattered memories and red pupils❄️ [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/04124281f26bd8986e466bd73882340d6c512a1b.png[/img]
[h3]🌙"Grand Tang Romance × Intellectual Game × Hidden Emotions Card-Flipping Secret Game"[/h3]
[quote=author] 🏮 Grand Tang Card-Flipping Secret Game: In the meticulously drawn national style card array, match suits/numbers, solve puzzles with intellect! Each level victory unlocks stunning standing illustrations, delving into the beauties' most hidden emotional worlds.
[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/32bfc7ebfba8e76c15012cbc621ba7cb11bba280.png[/img]
[quote=author] 🃏 Use "Elegant Intellectual Strategy" to crack the golden thread card bureaus, unlock 22 scenes of Grand Tang court secret scrolls from subtle tenderness🌸 to deep emotional revelation🌊!  [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/b95299fd10f7bbda5baf9ef47e3d924e298072dd.png[/img]
[quote=author] • Top-right corner provides “Reset Level🔁” and “Skip▶️” functions, after clearing don't forget to enter the album to relive touching moments～🎞️ [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/ab61bd71458191b47df2ddbc7ffe72a96cc8116f.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]💮 Game Features 💮 [/h3]
[list]
    [*]🏮 Easy Card-Flipping Gameplay: Click to match identical suits or numbers to eliminate cards, level victory directly unlocks stunning national style standing illustrations.
    [*]🎭 Five Great Beauties' Deep Charms:  Brothel Manager·Strategizing Behind the Scenes, Noble Twin Sisters·Mirror Flowers Water Moon, Night Cat Spirit Charm·Millennia Karma, White Hair Red Pupils·Shattered Memories Birth Emotions...Each past story is captivating.
    [*]🖌️ Exquisite National Style Graphics: Lavish costumes, retro scenes, a visual feast full of ancient charm, immersing you in the Grand Tang night banquet experience.
    [*]👘  Five Stunning Beauties: 22 characteristic standing illustrations customize your exclusive elegance! One-click skip for instant unlock~
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🌸 【 Five Great Beauties·Hundred States of Fragrance】[/h3]
[h3]🪭Talented Brothel Manager——Wan Qing[/h3][quote=author] Resolves countless storms with talk and laughter. Only to you does she devote her heart, hiding unknown tenderness.
“Don’t just stand there, let me teach you some fun things～” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/5ec33651469190bbc3dcd9a619c53c3aa1f1bf70.png[/img]
[h3]❄️Frivolous and Charming Noble Miss——Ying Xue[/h3]
[quote=author] Every word and action carries seductive charm, revealing full elegance in the flow of glances.
“Sister went out today, so it’s just us here today……” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/54138411496876331c25d03b969eddbc8149c35f.png[/img]
[h3]🎐Gentle and Learned Boudoir Jade——Ying Hua[/h3]
[quote=author] Proper and elegant in every gesture, only upon knowing you do ripples appear in her eyes.
“Let me see too, how you make sister happy?” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/3096a437922a862330806516f6742b1be4ac94ed.png[/img]
[h3]🌙Mysterious White-Haired Girl——Golan[/h3]
[quote=author] Crimson eyes hide shattered pasts. In careful care, affections quietly grow……
“Will this really make you feel comfortable?” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/7206e509ae41a2a7fb0238803dbef8a3306aaf55.png[/img]
[h3]🐾 Night Shadow Exquisite·Cat Spirit——Tian Jiao[/h3]
[quote=author] Lively silhouette encountered under the moon, enemy or friend? Beneath the quirky exterior surges millennia-old karma.
“Such a precious gift～I’ll accept it❤Hehe～” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/45c79d56acc4b6e85f2f0c966d2a056363bd0fb8.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🎴"This affection can await becoming a memory, but at the time it was already lost……"——Can this scroll of gilded dream drawings not betray longing?
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/90c00db63bb4bb3723647ac05a96a2b78796521a.png[/img]

notes.title: 👠Sweet New Work —— Hot and Lovely: Seduction💄 is Coming Soon on Steam!
notes.content:
[Lovely Games Studios] The beloved series has released a new work titled "Hot and Lovely: Seduction"! Expected to officially launch on the Steam platform on July 18th! 🧸💓

You accidentally step into the hidden world of four cute 2D girls
They are either sweet and innocent 🍬, or mature and seductive 💋, or playful and lively ✨, or even have a bit of a jerk... 😈 ⛓ ️

notes.title: 👒Days with girlfriends : Kello&Cammy（General direction） is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3] "A Day in the Life of a Contract Girlfriend: Kelly and Jamie (General Edition)" was developed by Lovely Games and released on Steam on February 21st. Choose your own "Contract Girlfriend📑"! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/e9ac9aee54dfdaa9ef17e2564647eceed607ad9d.png[/img]
[h2] ⚠ Note: This game is a general version of another game, and the content is consistent. Please do not purchase again! [/h2]

[h3]🏡Game Background🏡:[/h3]
After graduation, you arrived in the romantic town you had longed for and began a brand new life. However, peaceful days were disrupted by a special dating event—the "contractual girlfriend" experience. It sounds great, doesn't it?
In a day, you need to get to know them well and even experience them deeply. And ultimately, you will choose one of them and sign the final contract with her.
[h3] 🎆 It's about choosing the gentle sister who was once ambiguous,
🎆Still a beautiful DJ eager to try? [/h3]
Every choice will determine the story's course, from morning till night, experience a romantic 💕 day that belongs to you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/590f439e32e12e29bc91433afa25548f0ecc5f59.png[/img]
[h3]💟 Game Introduction💟:[/h3]
This is a casual game that blends gameplay by moving and matching colorful gems, forming three or more straight lines to eliminate them. Each successful elimination brings ✨ stunning effects✨ and 🎉 satisfying sound effects🎉, along with corresponding picture erasure effects below. ! Note that you need to complete the task within the specified number of steps![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/190ae5b0d4f4d2ecd543c80bc2f40a0d9bad3058.png[/img]
The game features 12 levels, and clicking on the album after completing each level unlocks the scene illustrations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/8a3f998cab5acd579f403ec1abfd17ced1f8c9fa.png[/img]
To directly unlock the plot, you can also choose the skip option in the upper right corner of , and there are hidden achievements available for unlocking 😋

New highlights in this work:
[list]
    [*]2️⃣Two independent storylines:
Two distinctly different storylines take you into two entirely different worlds. Every choice you make will determine the plot's course, ultimately unlocking your unique ending. Is she a gentle sister or a fiery DJ? The key to destiny is in your hands, and it's up to you to steer the course of the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/a173e0d912ef7209c6ce67c1ea3abc1672578f5c.png[/img]
    [*]🔼Upgraded Consumer Fun Play:
The classic消乐玩法play has been comprehensively upgraded! Every precise elimination not only brings dazzling effects and satisfaction but also unlocks more exquisite CG images. As the game progresses, you will gradually uncover the story and experience an unprecedentedly exhilarating adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/234d6b2902af957e1f992078251a96c9019a25b4.png[/img]
    [*]🙆Rich character development:
Three-dimensional and vivid character portrayals bring each character to life. You can always look back at your "past" with the female protagonists, delve deeper into their inner worlds, and feel their joys, sorrows, and emotions. Every detail could serve as a basis for your choice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/6ef172ada36f97e8aac85ccd83c575073a4ac492.png[/img]
    [*]❣Upgrade by tapping ️ the page:
The new page tap feature offers more character interaction experiences, with each click taking you deeper into this emotional adventure💖.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/7103f75a85368da99ce0e701f74a5b80fb6e9039.png[/img]
    [*]😍 Character Eye Following Function:
Make your interaction more realistic. Their eyes👀 would change with your actions, as if they were having a silent conversation with you. Every eye contact could deepen the emotional bond between you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/705342bf8274e96525b24df18cd773ab6c61e739.png[/img]
No matter who you choose, the other one will be jealous (smiling).

[h2]🍒 Character Introduction ‖ Role Introduction🍒:[/h2]
[h3]🎶Kello🎶[/h3]
Outstanding beauty and an impressive figure have long made your stepmother's daughter fall in love with you. Former ambiguities and unexpressed emotions will gradually surface on this day. Familiar yet unfamiliar touches, irresistible experiences—should we continue our previous connection? 💖
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/adacbc12e9182b764fb2be350ffd4a296ebece4f.png[/img]
[h3] 🍸 ️ Gami 🍸 ️[/h3]
The carefree short-haired lady, fiery and sexy, fell in love with you at first sight at the tavern and yearned to further develop our relationship. As the role of a "contract girlfriend," she joined in this delicate emotional experience. Her preferences and charm make you irresistibly drawn to it. Should you start a new experiment? 🔥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197424/729c84d5101b57e229071e38018b4188648cb0ba.png[/img]
Jamie's addition has made this contractual relationship even more enigmatic. Will she be an observer of this emotion, or a new variable?
No matter what, you must choose the one you are most satisfied with after experiencing your girlfriend for a day and sign her final contract! ！！

[h2]🎉Upcoming release:[/h2]
